title: TTRacing releases first sofa gaming chair, partners with BT21
summary: MANILA, Philippines – TTRacing revealed the ORA Sofa Chair BT21 Collection, the company’s first sofa chair. This is also TTRacing’s first collaboration with music, featuring the 8 BT21 characters,…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – TTRacing revealed the ORA Sofa Chair BT21 Collection, the company’s first sofa chair.

This is also TTRacing’s first collaboration with music, featuring the 8 BT21 characters, CHIMMY, COOKY, KOYA, MANG, RJ, SHOOKY, TATA, and VAN. The partnership features a collector’s gift set containing character cards and stickers.
The sofa chair’s key features are a built-in device holder, powered recline, and a 240° swivel with rocking base.

Furniture for the gaming and music lifestyle
TTRacing is known for their line of gaming chairs, tables, and accessories, as well as their collaborations with anime and pop culture.
The partnership with BT21 marks the company’s shift to opening to the music industry.

“We were never just building for gamers. We were building for dreamers. For creators, innovators, music lovers, and people chasing ambitions far beyond the screen. Somewhere along the way, we stopped simply building for our community and started building alongside them,” said TTRacing COO & CMO, David A. Reyes in a press release.

“Our collaboration with BT21 marks another chapter in that journey, bringing music, nostalgia, and self-expression into our story. At the end of the day, everyone deserves a space to dream, belong, and simply be themselves. That’s what ORA Sofa Chair is all about.”
The TTRacing ORA sofa chair costs P39,999, down from its original price of P50,999.
